name: Decrypto

rounds.endCondition: Team with 2 Interception tokens wins; 2 Miscommunication tokens loses; tiebreak after round 8

categories.label: Interception tokens
categories.hint: +1 each time the team intercepts the opponent's code; 2 wins

categories.label: Team won
categories.hint: Win by 2 interceptions or opponent's 2 miscommunications; otherwise tiebreak

tiebreakers.description: Net tokens (+1 per Interception, -1 per Miscommunication); most wins
Each team guesses the opponent's four keywords; most correct wins

winCondition: Collect 2 Interception tokens to win; collect 2 Miscommunication tokens to lose. If both or neither happen by the end of round 8, higher net token score wins, then most correctly guessed enemy keywords; else shared victory.

endCondition.description: 2 Interception or 2 Miscommunication tokens, or end of round 8

notes: family: team-deduction. Text matches the official rules as reproduced by UltraBoardGames; official Scorpion Masque/IELLO PDF could not be downloaded to cross-check, so confidence is medium. Net score tiebreak is shown as per-category values but not counted to total.
